name: knaithe
brief: Unit 42 documented a Chinese-speaking "opportunistic exploit operator and self-described binary security researcher," based in Zhuhai, China, who ran DeepSeek autonomously via the "Hermes Agent" framework (C2'd over Telegram) to enumerate 460+ internet-exposed targets across 7 CVEs — including a Langflow RCE — using FOFA, source and adapt public PoC exploit code, launch autonomous exploitation attempts, and adaptively re-target on failure, largely without human intervention. Confirmed real-world impact included data exfiltration from three organizations and code execution on 11 Marimo notebook instances; a recovered Hermes Agent session log is dated May 7, 2026. The actor also configured/evaluated Claude Code (limited to connectivity/proxy testing), Codex, Qwen Code, GLM, Kimi and MiniMax. *Bias note: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 (vendor); this is a first-party technical writeup of a specific observed incident, not aggregate marketing statistics.* Unit 42
